item.title: Jason Todd Meahl - Villages-News.com
item.description: Jason Meahl had a unique talent for finding treasures in what others would consider junk. His sense of humor was unparalleled, and he could light up any room with his quick wit and infectious laughter.

item.title: Reader has harsh words for Villagers in ICE protest - Villages-News.com
item.description: A reader from Leesburg has some harsh words for the Villagers who took part in a protest over ICE.

item.title: Jacqueline Hope Hart - Villages-News.com
item.description: Jacqueline Hart was a beloved matriarch of her family. She dedicated her life to her children and grandchildren. Jacqueline was the owner and founder of Abby’s Flower Shop and a Florida Affair.

item.title: Consultant claims Lake Pan landfill odor problem has been resolved - Villages-News.com
item.description: A persistent odor problem last year at the Heart of Florida landfill near Lake Panasoffkee has been resolved, according to a consultant's report.

item.title: Haley Brooke Johnson - Villages-News.com
item.description: Haley Johnson was a Baptist in her faith. Haley enjoyed fishing, collecting antiques and coins and loved her dogs, “Tank” and “Tiddy”. She enjoyed being outdoors, and helping with cattle.

item.title: Renee Good’s death could have been avoided - Villages-News.com
item.description: A Village of Bradford reader believes that Renee Good’s death could have been avoided.

item.title: Eugene Charles Olsson - Villages-News.com
item.description: Eugene Olsson was a longtime golfer and loved nothing more than a round with good friends. He was a great cook, avid mystery reader and devoted watcher of Jeopardy.

item.title: Woman arrested after spraying dogs with water hose at park in Lady Lake - Villages-News.com
item.description: A woman in Lady Lake was arrested after using a city-owned utility box to spray dogs from the fountain in Heritage Park.

item.title: Patricia E. Collins - Villages-News.com
item.description: Patricia Collins had a passion for travel and was fortunate to see much of the world with Bob, from Alaskan cruises to memorable trips to Ireland and beyond. She was also a lifelong lover of cats and dogs.

item.title: Democratic demonstrators in The Villages are hypocrites - Villages-News.com
item.description: A Villager contends that Democratic demonstrators protesting against ICE are hypocrites.
